integrity: All algebraic identities are shown in a complete proof, with a standalone symbolic verification program and direct finite-field checks. The finite checks are examples, not substitutes for the uniform proof. Literature comparisons are nonexhaustive.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for F_q-rational singular points and their geometric local germs. Singularities over field extensions, geometric irreducibility, and geometric smoothness of the pencil are not determined.
title: Rational nodes and cusps in a plane-filling pencil
